test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - GA (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following pairs is NOT correct about the indigenous dog breeds of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chippiparai - Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chippiparai** is an indigenous sighthound breed that originates from the **Tamil Nadu** state of India, specifically around the **Madurai**, **Theni**, and **Virudhunagar** districts. It was traditionally bred by royal families in **Chippiparai** near **Rajapalayam** for hunting small game like boar and deer. **Hence, the pair Chippiparai - Kerala is not correct.**
 
• **Gaddi Dog**, also known as the **Himalayan Sheepdog** or **Indian Panther Hound**, is found in the **Himalayan** region, including **Himachal Pradesh**, **Uttarakhand**, and parts of **Jammu and Kashmir**. It is a sturdy livestock guardian dog used by the **Gaddi** tribe. **Hence, the pair Gaddi Dog - Jammu and Kashmir is correct.**
 
• **Combai** (or **Kombai**) is a powerful and loyal terrier-type dog native to the **Theni** district of **Tamil Nadu**. Historically, they were used for hunting and guarding, and they are known for their distinctive ridge of hair on their back. **Hence, the pair Combai - Tamil Nadu is correct.**
 
• **Mudhol Hound** is a renowned sighthound from the **Mudhol** region of **Bagalkot** district in **Karnataka**. It is famous for its incredible speed, stamina, and sharp vision, making it an excellent hunter. **Hence, the pair Mudhol Hound - Karnataka is correct.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rajapalayam**: This is another iconic breed from **Tamil Nadu**, characterized by its milky white coat, pink nose, and golden eyes. It was used by the **Nayakar** dynasty and later in the **Polygar Wars** against the British.
 
• **Rampur Hound**: Originating from the **Rampur** region of **Uttar Pradesh**, this sighthound was a favorite of the **Nawabs of Rampur**. It is built for speed and was used to hunt jackals, leopards, and even lions.
 
• **Kanni**: Closely related to the **Chippiparai**, the **Kanni** is a sighthound from **Tamil Nadu**. The name **Kanni** means **maiden**, as these dogs were traditionally given as part of a dowry to brides.
 
• **Jonangi**: This breed is native to the **Andhra Pradesh** region. It is unique for its short coat and its habit of making a **yodeling** sound instead of a typical bark. It was traditionally used for herding ducks.
 
• **Bakharwal Dog**: Found in the **Pir Panjal** range of the **Himalayas**, this breed is kept by the **Bakharwal** and **Gujjar** nomadic tribes of **Jammu and Kashmir** to protect their livestock from predators like wolves and bears.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **National Bureau of Animal Genetic Resources (NBAGR)**: Located in **Karnal**, **Haryana**, this institute under the **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)** is the nodal agency for the registration and documentation of indigenous animal breeds, including dogs.
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat and Indian Breeds**: In **August 2020**, Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** highlighted the importance of Indian dog breeds in his **Mann Ki Baat** address. He urged citizens to adopt local breeds to promote self-reliance and preserve India's biological heritage.
 
• **Military Induction**: The **Indian Army** made history in **2016** by inducting the **Mudhol Hound** into the **Remount Veterinary Corps (RVC)**. These dogs are trained for border surveillance, tracking, and explosive detection due to their high intelligence and physical agility.
 
• **Conservation Status**: Many indigenous breeds like the **Himalayan Mastiff** and **Alangu Mastiff** are facing the risk of extinction due to cross-breeding and the popularity of foreign breeds. Efforts are being made by various state governments to set up breeding centers to preserve their **genetic purity**.
